10.title: Island count and origin
10.prompt: A poster calls every Indian island coral or hardened lava and quotes 247 as a verified current total. Explain the limitations.
solution: Andaman and Nicobar lie in the Bay of Bengal; Lakshadweep lies in the Arabian Sea and is associated with coral formations.

Indira Point is on Great Nicobar. Andaman–Nicobar belongs to a tectonic island-arc setting with volcanic features such as Barren Island; saying every island is simply hardened volcanic rock is too broad. Gulf of Mannar has coral-associated islands too. The book’s 247 = 204 + 43 is a source count, not a verified current national island inventory; inventories vary by date and criteria.
